segment: Students from Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan applying for bachelor's degrees abroad (and at international campuses at home), intake 2027
selection_rule: Bundled catalogue only (data/generated/catalogue/list.json). (1) For each destination in DESTINATION_QUOTAS (US 28, GB 18, DE 14, KR 14, TR 14, MY 10, CN 12, JP 10, IT 10, HU 8, PL 8, CZ 6, CA 10, RU 10, AE 6, SG 4, HK 6), take universities in that country that have a position in the latest installed QS (2027), THE (2026) or ARWU (2026) world edition; best rank = lowest position (band floor for banded entries) across those three. Sort by best rank, then name. Take the top ceil(quota/2), then floor(quota/2) more evenly spaced over the remaining ranked list (index floor((i+0.5)*rest/spread)), so lower, cheaper bands are included. Unranked universities are never picked for destinations. (2) Add 16 named international/foreign-partner/English-medium institutions inside UZ, KZ, KG, TJ (HOME_CAMPUSES, exact name + country). Ranking is a proxy for where this segment applies; we have no application-volume data, and English-taught or scholarship status is not a usable field yet, so the owner should swap in known favourites. Generated by scripts/segment/select-targets.ts.
